summary: Flat bend at the kerb's end; homes 12-15 m away, vacant lot behind.

drivers.seclusion: Trees and gardens screen the east side, but houses sit 12-15 m away; a vacant lot lies further up.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a wide bend; one car parked opposite, room for a van at the kerb.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street; light through traffic.
drivers.convention: 2P Mon-Fri 7am-7pm, resident permits excepted; little kerbside parking.

flags: Steep above 38 m: 0-25 m is about 15%, but the bend is flat
Homes within 10-25 m on the section's own side
Esri shows the upper east houses demolished, but QLD still shows them
sun_shade: Tree canopy over the east kerb shades the bend from the east and south; open to the west.
cannot_judge: Whether the vacant lot is being redeveloped

best_section.where: Around the bend into Manchester Terrace, east kerb below the vacant lot
